subject: BrightGrid POC: technical handoff, success criteria and SDK streaming plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: BrightGrid POC: technical handoff, success criteria and SDK streaming plan

Hi Leah / Samir —

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap from our call and the concrete next steps so everyone has alignment for the POC kickoff: 

POC objective (agreed):
- Validate Redwood inference for BrightGrid’s customer support routing use case: accurate intent classification + entity extraction under 1s median latency at 8 TPS.

Success criteria (you confirmed):
- Intent accuracy >= 92% on the validation set (20k messages).
- Entity F1 >= 0.88 for the top 5 entity types.
- Median generation latency < 1s, P99 < 2.5s, measured from BrightGrid app to Redwood-hosted endpoint.
- Total inference cost during POC below $600 for the 2-week pilot (as a sanity check).

Technical scope / integration points:
- SDK integration (Python) for streaming inference in the user agent flow. We’ll provide a lightweight sample and a route mapping for existing event payloads.
- API routes: /v1/generate (sync) and /v1/stream (streaming SSE) will be used.
- Tool calling: if you want automations to the triage system, we’ll demo function/tool-calling with a mocked triage API.

Owners & timeline:
- BrightGrid owner: Samir (integration lead), Derek (engineering).
- Redwood owner (technical): Ben Carter — SDK + runtime tweaks.
- Redwood owner (customer success): Jonas Weber — project coordination and acceptance gates.
- Kickoff (technical): next Tuesday 9/21. Two-week trial window: 9/22–10/05.

Attachments: integration matrix + sample API contract + SDK streaming sample (attached).

Immediate asks before kickoff:
1) Leah/Samir: confirm kickoff date and internal stakeholder invite list.
2) Derek (if available): share a short example of the current event payload (1–2 sample messages) so we can validate mapping.
3) Redwood (Ben/Jonas): confirm any rate-limit exemptions or burst capacity needed for the first 48 hours of the trial.

I’ll follow up with a short action tracker and a pre-kickoff checklist by Friday.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Leah —

Looping in Marissa (our SDK/streaming lead) and dropping a short technical plan + sample mapping inline so Derek can sanity-check quickly.

Quick plan highlights:
- SDK: we’ll provide a lightweight Python client (attached) that supports both sync and streaming flows. Streaming uses chunked SSE on /v1/stream and emits two event types: data-chunk and tool-call.
- API routes: POST /v1/generate (json body), POST /v1/stream (Accept: text/event-stream). Authorization via Bearer token.
- Tool calling: Redwood will accept a functions array in the request; during streaming we’ll emit a tool_call event with function name and arguments. You can POST back to your triage API or we can proxy it.

Sample mapping (example):
- BrightGrid event -> Redwood SDK call: {
    "user_id": "bg-xyz-123",
    "text": "Customer: My invoice is wrong",
    "metadata": {"source":"web-chat","priority":"low"}
  }

- Streaming response (SSE) -> sequence: data-chunk (partial tokens) -> data-chunk (final) -> tool_call (suggested triage action with ticket_id and labels).

Example curl (sync):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"My invoice is wrong","mode":"intent_and_entities"}'

Example Python streaming snippet (attached full in redwood-sdk-streaming-sample.py):
- from redwood import StreamingClient
- client = StreamingClient(api_key="<token>")
- with client.stream("/v1/stream", payload) as stream:
    for event in stream:
        if event.type == 'data-chunk':
            print(event.text, end='')
        elif event.type == 'tool_call':
            # event.args contains {"ticket_id":..., "labels": [...]}
            requests.post('https://staging.brightgrid.com/triage', json=event.args)

Ownership / next steps:
- Ben: will provision temp burst to 12 TPS for 24 hours starting 9/22 09:00 PT.
- Marissa: will post a trimmed SDK sample and a checklist for integration by EOD 9/15.
- Jonas: will send the pre-kickoff checklist and the acceptance script that BrightGrid can run on 9/30.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
